notes.title: Update for April 28: Mac version live!
notes.content: I finally managed to upload a mac version of this. Hopefully it works well enough!

notes.title: Update Notes for Jan 5
notes.content: This patch fixes an issue with an item based achievement. It also fixes a bug with one of the items not correctly resetting upon death.

Fixing bug where Time Stop would keep time stopped on death.

Adding a reload of achievements on game start for anyone who missed achievements on launch.

I'm still Tshooting an issue where achievements didn't trigger for a friend of mine, unclear what the root cause is.

notes.title: Update Notes 1.0.1.2
notes.content: I noticed a few levels in world 2 were slightly off. very small tweaks to obstacle layout
Shop Explanation Videos were missing, that's been fixed
Fixing Steam Achievements: some of the additional files needed weren't included in the steam download
